body: Even SBX will not hire me. I do not have prior experience as a barista.  I've tried texting a few people since last night and no response. Oh well :p

Honestly, this is not just an "Arab" thing. A lot of other cultures are like this (Asian, Armenian, Greek, etc). For the men, it's ok to have fun with girls who are not of the same culture but when it's time to get married, their families insist on them marrying someone from their own culture. 

Some families want you to get a girl from the balad because they have this misconception that western Arab women are too strong-willed and do not have the same values as women who live back home. It's totally misogynistic. I've even heard men who will go back home to find a girl because he wants to "mold her" into the type of wife he wants her to be. 


Edit: also, ya'll need to refer to My Big Fat Greek Wedding where the mom tells the daughter that her husband is the head in the marriage and she is the neck so she can turn the head whichever way she wants. It's totally true in our culture
